headline.zh: 和平公园水榭里的亲水平台
headline.en: Lakeside terrace inside Peace Park's waterside pavilion

traits.zh: 室外亲水平台设桌椅和遮阳棚，可一览湖光
traits.en: Outdoor lakeside terrace with seating and sun shade, offering views of the lake

traits.zh: 室内分三区：西区服务台、中区透明顶棚绿意环绕、东区豆袋沙发与书架
traits.en: Interior divided into three zones: service counter (west), glass-roofed green zone (center), beanbag-and-bookshelf area (east)

traits.zh: 提供肉桂卷等烘焙食品
traits.en: Serves cinnamon rolls and other baked goods

traits.zh: 室内有木桌椅，东区设豆袋懒人沙发
traits.en: Indoor seating includes wooden tables/chairs and beanbag loungers in the east zone

linger.zh: 亲水平台+多类型座位+书架

focus.zh: 东区设书架，中区绿意环绕
focus.en: Bookshelf in east zone; green-focused center zone
